title: effect-size-conversion-v1 player output
description: The result of one effect-size conversion: the converted value in the target metric plus a confidence. Optional `formula`/`note` strings may document the identity used; omit them (do not send null) when unused.

converted.description: The value converted into the target metric.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the converted value.

formula.description: Optional. The closed-form identity used. Omit when unused.

note.description: Optional free-text note. Omit when unused.
